name: The Wedding Furnace
pitch: Serve your enemy a five-course feast: every plate keeps every coating on the plates before it, so the order you loaded the furnace decides the fight, and a guest who comes unannounced finds only a cold stove.

new.name: Open-Door Furnace
new.effect: New artifact base dan_lo, attack 46, defence 20, thần thức 30. Opens Five Courses. Closes: a loaded coating serves nothing else, blind nothing can be loaded, and the art ends with the meal.

new.name: Five Courses
new.effect: Each firing serves the next loaded course, which keeps every earlier coating; a course the last did not generate resets the total to 0.
new.second_home: any Five Phases Cycle or slot-order build

new.name: Cook's Hand
new.effect: +4 points per alchemy level on hits with the furnace form.
new.second_home: any alchemist with a hồ lô or furnace art

new.name: Fine Work
new.effect: Coatings you brewed gain 20 % per point of quality, 0 to 3.
new.second_home: any talisman or formation crafter who fights with their own work

new.name: Boiled Over
new.effect: Each L4 point the cap clips on a course adds 0.01 c_tick to a body tick, Scald, for 3 pulses.
new.second_home: any formation or coating stack past L4's cap

new.name: Wedding Hearth Sutra
new.effect: Main, Địa giai, Fire. Low Flame; three courses at layer 4, five at layer 7, Boiled Over at layer 9. Has no chapter on eating in a hurry.

new.name: Open the Door
new.effect: Furnace active effect: c_art 2.2, cost 0.10, 1 s. Serves the next course; with none left it does not fire.

new.name: Kitchen-Door Pill
new.effect: Any coating pressed into a pill, +8 toxicity. A ready dose may be loaded in an Ambush.

new.name: Long Table
new.effect: Sealed by the Wedding Hearth Sutra, theme the Way of Alchemy, Fire, size 8. Notables Cook's Hand, then Fine Work.

questions: No coating has a recipe or a price. Should a meal cost a season's work, or only goods?
Whetstone Ash at 60 makes Earth first nearly dominant. Should the four coatings be resized, now that one build uses all of them?
